sources.source_name: TIME: Apple expands its business-computer market
sources.notes: Contemporary report: Macintosh SE and Macintosh II expanded the business market; second fiscal quarter revenue was $637 million, up 42%. The copy does not use later full-year results for earlier endpoints.

sources.source_name: UPI: Apple unveils new personal computer
sources.notes: Contemporary report on the smaller, less expensive Macintosh IIcx, aimed at business users.
Indexed original archive report consulted: 400 layoffs and reserves for restructuring and severance.

Original company fact book used retrospectively for dated milestones: 1984 leadership, 1987 store, 1989 Disney-MGM Studios, 1992 Euro Disney, 1994 Lion King and Paris refinancing, and February 1996 completion of the ABC acquisition. Only in-window milestones are used; the publication day is not established.
Indexed original archive report consulted: first fiscal quarter revenue rose to about $1.3 billion from $1.0 billion; The Little Mermaid and Roger Rabbit home video helped film revenue grow 23%.

sources.source_name: UPI: Disney earnings up 9 percent in fourth quarter
sources.notes: Indexed original archive report consulted: Disney reported record full-year revenue and earnings. The 9% headline is a quarter measure, not the full-year growth rate.
Indexed original archive report consulted: 1988 net income about $1.04 billion, up 14%, and sales about $8.34 billion, up 8.9%.
